zh: 空调不制冷，一直感觉很热。
old_en: I'm afraid the AC isn't cooling, so it keeps feeling hot.
new_en: The AC isn't cooling, so I feel really hot.

zh: 这台空调不制冷，房间越来越热。
old_en: This AC isn't cooling, and the room keeps getting hotter.
new_en: This AC isn't working, the room is getting hotter.

zh: 房间太吵，我害怕晚上睡不着。
old_en: I'm afraid the room is too noisy; I fear I'll sleeplessness at night.
new_en: The room is too noisy, I'm worried I won't sleep tonight.

zh: 外卖送得太慢，我担心饭菜都凉了。
old_en: The delivery is too slow; I'm afraid the food will be cold.
new_en: The delivery is too slow, I'm afraid the food will be cold.

zh: 这个外卖一直送不到，我怕要饿肚子了。
old_en: The delivery keeps not coming, so I'm afraid I'll starve.
new_en: The delivery hasn't arrived yet, I'm worried I'll go hungry.

zh: 新杯子漏水，我怕会弄湿桌子。
old_en: This is too leaky, I'm afraid it'll wet the table.
new_en: This new cup is leaking, I'm afraid it might wet the table.

zh: 新买的杯子漏水，有点不太方便。
old_en: I'm afraid this new cup is too leaky, a bit inconvenient.
new_en: This new cup leaks, it's a bit inconvenient.

zh: 我担心会议时间会延误，因为同事们总是迟到。
old_en: I'm afraid the meeting might run late, as colleagues are always late.
new_en: I'm worried the meeting will be delayed because colleagues are always late.

zh: 网速太慢，我怕下载资料会耽误时间。
old_en: The internet's too slow, I'm afraid it'll waste time downloading.
new_en: The internet is too slow, I'm worried it will waste time downloading files.

zh: 网速一直很慢，这让我担心项目赶不上期限。
old_en: Internet speed has always been slow, I'm afraid we'll miss the deadline.
new_en: The internet speed is always slow, I'm worried we might miss the deadline.

zh: 这道菜太咸，我怕吃不下。
old_en: This soup is too salty, I'm afraid I can't finish it.
new_en: This dish is too salty, I'm worried I won't be able to eat it.

zh: 网速太慢了，我怕会影响会议。
old_en: I'm afraid this internet keeps freezing, which could really mess up the presentation.
new_en: The internet is too slow, I'm worried it might affect the meeting.

zh: 这个房间隔音太差，吵得我有点睡不着。
old_en: This is too noisy, I'm afraid, and it keeps me from sleeping.
new_en: The room is too noisy, I'm worried it will keep me awake.

zh: 这道菜太咸了，我实在吃不下去。
old_en: This is too salty, I'm afraid I can't finish it.
new_en: This dish is too salty, I really can't eat it.

zh: 酒店的热水不够热，洗澡太难受了。
old_en: This is too cold, making the bath so uncomfortable.
new_en: The hot water is not hot enough, taking a shower is really uncomfortable.

zh: 这热水一直温度不够，我怕洗完澡会着凉。
old_en: This is too cold, I'm afraid I'll catch a cold after taking a bath.
new_en: The hot water is always not hot enough, I'm worried I might catch a cold after showering.

zh: 快递一直没送到，我有点着急。
old_en: It keeps not arriving, and I'm afraid it will be too late for the meeting.
new_en: The delivery hasn't arrived yet, and I'm getting worried.

zh: 预约的出租车一直没来，我担心会迟到。
old_en: This is too frustrating; I'm afraid the taxi will keep making us late.
new_en: The booked taxi hasn't come, and I'm worried I'll be late.

zh: 这个会议室的空调太冷了，我怕着凉。
old_en: This is too cold, I'm afraid I might catch a cold.
new_en: The air conditioning in this meeting room is too cold, I'm afraid I might get sick.

zh: 这网速一直不稳定，我怕会耽误工作。
old_en: This is too slow, I'm afraid it will delay my work.
new_en: The internet speed is still unstable, I'm worried it will affect my work.
